note: Majority and work: not read. Palau's National Code is published on PacLII (refused, Cloudflare); the Ministry of Human Resources' copy of 33 PNCA (Public Service Employment) holds no age rule; the ILO's Child Labour Observatory profile says the Labor Code sets a working age of sixteen for citizens and twenty-one for non-citizens, citing the US State Department's 2022 human rights report, which refused this client (403); null for both. Service: the Compact of Free Association between Palau and the United States (in force 1994), section 341: a Palauan citizen may volunteer for the US armed forces but isn't subject to involuntary induction into US military service while not habitually resident in the United States, its territories or possessions; the ILO profile adds that Palau maintains no armed forces. So none (my reading).

sources.title: US Department of the Interior: Compact of Free Association between the United States and Palau
sources.said: shall not be subject to involuntary induction into military service of the United States so long as such person does not establish habitual residence in the United States, its territories or possessions

sources.title: ILO Child Labour Observatory: Country profile Palau
sources.said: Palau maintains no armed forces and therefore has no provisions for compulsory military recruitment of any age.
